summary: BrilliA Inc, a Singapore-based apparel company, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, reporting fiscal year 2026 financial results and a strategic growth outlook via press release. The filing covers routine annual results: revenue of $49.0 million (down from $64.4 million), positive operating cash flow of $0.3 million, pre-tax income of $0.3 million, and $3.3 million in dividends ($0.13 per share). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The company expects revenue growth in fiscal 2027 based on Q1 preliminary results. This is a standard periodic report, not a special situation.
